ex: Ominous creakings and grindings came from the innards of the machine.

senses.d: The action of grinding a workpiece to change its size, shape, and surface finish.
ex: Grinding sometimes involves tight tolerances on the order of a few microns.

senses.d: A form of dance in which two people rub their bodies together.
ex: No grinding is allowed on the dance floor at the junior prom: it isn't age-appropriate.

senses.d: Repeatedly performing the same quest or similar in-game activity in order to amass points or wealth.
ex: I really hate the grinding to get that 1% chance item.

senses.d: The act of doing the daily grind.
ex: A: Hey Bob, how's it goin? B: Meh, I'm tired of grinding, man.

senses.d: Of or pertaining to the act or gratingly sound of grinding.
ex: The meeting came to a grinding halt when the two sides could not agree.

senses.d: Relentlessly taxing; burdensome; exacting to the point of exhaustion.
ex: A week of filled with grinding toil.

senses.d: Crushing; oppressive; overwhelming.
